product.name: Monoprice High Speed HDMI Cable with HDMI Mini Connector - 4K@60Hz HDR 18Gbps YCbCr 444 30AWG 6ft Black
product.description: Enhance your home entertainment experience with the Monoprice™ High‑Speed HDMI Cable featuring an HDMI Mini Connector, designed to deliver stunning visual and audio quality for your high‑definition devices. Whether you're capturing unforgettable moments with your HD camcorder or streaming content from your favorite media players, this cable ensures seamless connectivity and uncompromising performance.Featuring an HDMI Mini Connector (Type C) on one end and a regular HDMI Connector (Type A) on the other, this cable offers versatile compatibility with a wide range of devices, making it an essential accessory for any home theater setup or multimedia system. The HDMI Mini Connector provides a compact and convenient solution for connecting your camcorder directly to your television, eliminating the need for cumbersome adapters or multiple cables.Built to deliver exceptional performance, this High‑Speed HDMI Cable supports an impressive 18Gbps data throughput, ensuring lightning‑fast transmission of high‑definition content with minimal latency. The 30AWG copper conductors provide reliable signal integrity, reducing signal loss and ensuring consistently sharp and clear images.Despite its compact size, the cable is engineered to meet the demands of today's high‑resolution displays and advanced audio systems. The full‑size HDMI connector head measures only 15.8mm thick and 25.0mm wide, while the HDMI Mini connector head measures a mere 13.5mm thick and 19.0mm wide, allowing for easy installation in tight spaces or behind wall‑mounted displays.Equipped with gold‑plated connectors, this cable ensures maximum conductivity and corrosion resistance, minimizing signal degradation and providing a reliable connection for years to come. Whether you're enjoying your favorite movies, streaming high‑definition content, or gaming with friends, you can trust this cable to deliver exceptional performance every time.With support for a wide range of HDMI features, including 1080p resolution at 60Hz, 4K resolution at 60Hz, 3D video, and Deep Color up to 16‑bits per channel, this cable offers unparalleled versatility for all your multimedia needs. Additionally, it supports x.v.Color™ and YCbCr 4:4:4 color space, allowing for vibrant and lifelike color reproduction that brings your content to life on the screen.Experience immersive, high‑definition audio with support for High Definition Audio formats, including SA‑CD, DVD‑Audio, DTS‑HD Master Audio™, and Dolby TrueHD™. Whether you're enjoying cinematic soundtracks or immersive gaming experiences, this cable ensures that every audio detail is faithfully reproduced with pristine clarity and precision.In summary, the Monoprice™ High‑Speed HDMI Cable with HDMI Mini Connector is the perfect choice for connecting your HD camcorder or other HDMI‑enabled devices to your television or display. With its compact design, high‑speed data transmission, and wide range of supported features, this cable delivers unparalleled performance and reliability, allowing you to enjoy your favorite content with stunning visual and audio quality.This High Speed HDMI Cable features an HDMI Mini Connector (Type C) on the source end and a regular HDMI Connector (Type A) on the other end.
